representativeSnapshot.kind: production-like snapshot with representative row counts and text distributions for every indexed surface

rowCountQueries: Capture relation sizes and qualifying public-row counts for profiles, artists, venues, organizations, events, events_v2, tours, music, posts, and jobs
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Generated search vectors are materialized for existing rows in every affected table; no business values are changed

execution.resumeStrategy: Apply one guarded generated column or index at a time and resume from the first missing catalog object
execution.resumeCursor: Supabase migration version 20260801221454 plus last verified index name
execution.idempotency: Extensions, generated columns, and indexes use IF NOT EXISTS

quarantine.strategy: Abort on incompatible column definitions and repair additively; no tenant keys or relationships are inferred

indexes: partial GIN full-text and trigram indexes for public discovery surfaces
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Measure build time, lock duration, index size, query plans, visibility predicates, and search parity before and after migration

recovery.rollback: Keep application search on the prior query path and remove invalid indexes through a reviewed forward migration
recovery.forwardFix: Create missing indexes concurrently where required and repair generated expressions additively

queries: Verify every index is valid and used by representative public search queries without exposing non-public rows
